home.title: Echo of the syrian Citizen
home.description: Echo of the Citizen is a Syrian digital platform that empowers people to submit complaints easily, track them in real time, and receive instant updates. With strong security, transparent data management, and accessible tools on mobile and web, citizens can raise their voice clearly and follow every step until resolution.

agencies.title: Government Agencies Directory
agencies.description: Browse our directory of government agencies and departments. Selecting the correct authority for your complaint ensures it's handled by the right team for faster resolution and better service.
